sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service Act 1952
sections.description:
Short title application and commencement

THE PAKISTAN ARMED FORCES NURSING
THE PAKISTAN ARMED FORCES NURSING
SERVICE ACT, 1952.
ACT No. XXXVI of 1952
[For Statement of Objects and
Reasons, see Gaz. of P., Ext., 1952, 498.]
[5th May,
1952]
An Act to constitute a force to be called the [Pakistan Armed Forces
Nursing Service] and to provide for its discipline.
[Subs. by the Pakistan Military Nursing Service (Amdt.) Act,
1953 (39 of 1953), s. 2 for Pakistan Military Nursing Service .]
1. Short title application and commencement.‑(1) This Act may
be called the [Subs. by the Pakistan Military Nursing
Service (Amdt.) Act, 1953 (39 of 1953), s. 2 for Pakistan Military Nursing
Service .] [Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service] Act, 1952.
(2) It applies to the members of
the 2[Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service] wherever they may be.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the tenth day of May, 1951.

[Subs. by the Pakistan Military Nursing Service (Amdt.) Act,
1953 (39 of 1953), s. 2 for Pakistan Military Nursing Service .]
6. Eligibility for
appointment.‑(1) Any female citizen [The
original words above the age of 21 years omitted by Act 5 of 1963, s. 4.] *
* *, shall be eligible for appointment as an officer in the [Subs. by Act 39 of 1953, s. 2 for Pakistan Military Nursing
Service .] [Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service] and, if she satisfies
the prescribed conditions, may be appointed thereto in the manner laid down in
section 5 of this Act.
Provided that a
woman who is not a citizen of Pakistan but who otherwise fulfils the conditions
laid down by, or under this section for a citizen of Pakistan, may, with the
consent of the Central Government, signified in writing, be appointed as an
officer in the [Subs. by Act 39 of 1953, s. 2 for
Pakistan Military Nursing Service .] [Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing
Service].
(2) Every person so appointed
shall be subject to this Act and to the rules and regulations made there-under.

Application of the Pakistan Army Act, 1952, the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953, and the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961, to members of the Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Services

THE PAKISTAN ARMED FORCES NURSING
THE PAKISTAN ARMED FORCES NURSING
SERVICE ACT, 1952.
ACT No. XXXVI of 1952
[For Statement of Objects and
Reasons, see Gaz. of P., Ext., 1952, 498.]
[5th May,
1952]
An Act to constitute a force to be called the [Pakistan Armed Forces
Nursing Service] and to provide for its discipline.
[Subs. by the Pakistan Military Nursing Service (Amdt.) Act,
1953 (39 of 1953), s. 2 for Pakistan Military Nursing Service .]
9. Application of the Pakistan Army Act, 1952, the Pakistan Air Force
Act, 1953, and the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961, to members of the Pakistan
Armed Forces Nursing Services. [Subs. by the
Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service (Arndt.) Act, 1963 (5 of 1963), s. 6 for
the existing section 9 which was first subs. by the Pakistan Military Nursing
Service (Arndt.) Act, 1953 (39 of 1953), and then amended by the Central Laws
(Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960).]‑(1) The provisions
of the Pakistan Army Act, 1952, shall, to such extent and subject to such
adaptation and modifica tions as may be prescribed, apply to officers of the
Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service, who may be serving with forces . and
persons subject to that Act as those provisions apply to officers of the
Pakistan Army. XXXIX of 1952.
(2) The provisions of the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953,
shall. to such extent and subject to such adaptations and modifications as may
be prescribed, apply to officers of the Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service,
who may be serving with forces and persons subject to that Act as those provisions
apply to officers of the Pakistan Air Force. VI of 1953.
(3) The provisions of the
Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961, shall, to such extent and subject to such
adaptations and modifications as may be prescribed, apply to officers of the
Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service, who may be serving with forces and
persons subject to that Ordinance as those provisions apply to officers of the
Pakistan Navy.] XXXV of 1964.

10. Power to make rules.‑(I)
The Central Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, make rules
to carry out the purposes of this Act. [For the
Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service Rules, 1956, see Gaz. of P., 1956, Pt.
III, pp. 23‑24.]
(2) In particular and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing power, rules may be made under
this section,‑
(a) providing
for the medical examination of persons offering themselves for appointment in
the [Subs. by Act 39 of 1953, s. 2, for Pakistan
Military Nursing Service .] [Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service]; and
(b) providing
for any matter which under this Act is to be or may be prescribed.
